audit.whatIsWrong: Hammer Shock is called a knockup in five places: spikes[0] 'Poppy's Q knockup disrupts your stack-fishing', wants.foe[0] 'Use Q knockup to interrupt', content.mid 'her Q knockup interrupts your stack build', whys[1] 'Poppy hits Q knockup at level 2', whys[2] 'a level-3 Q knockup'.
audit.why: Hammer Shock deals damage and creates a zone that slows and then explodes after a delay. There is no knockup in it. The knockups in Poppy's kit belong to Keeper's Verdict (R) and, indirectly, to Heroic Charge (E) when it pins into a wall. Believing her basic poke displaces you produces exactly the wrong reaction — the correct one is to step off the zone before the delayed explosion.
audit.corrected: Hammer Shock slows and leaves a zone that explodes on a delay. Walk off the plate; nothing about it displaces you.
sources: champ-data/_kits/poppy.json Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, R Keeper's Verdict

audit.whatIsWrong: Keeper's Verdict is treated as an unanswerable counter to Devour — 'her R is a hard answer to Devour', 'it hard-counters Devour', 'invalidating your signature play until her R is down'. The one interaction that flips this is absent.
audit.why: Keeper's Verdict is a channel. Any hard crowd control cancels it, and Tahm Kench's 3-stack Tongue Lash stun is hard crowd control — the missing-interactions file flags this pairing from Poppy's side as exactly that ('Tahm Kench can cancel your Keeper's Verdict (R) with Tongue Lash (Q)'). She is also untargetable during it, which is why spending damage into the channel is wasted while spending the stun is not. It is 140s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Do not fear Keeper's Verdict — hold the 3-stack stun for it. Hard CC cancels the channel, and she is untargetable while it runs, so damage into it is thrown away.
sources: champ-data/_kits/_missing-interactions.json poppy vs tahmkench your-channel-punished; tahmkench vs poppy untargetable-dodges-burst

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late and whys[6] say 'Poppy's W is completely wasted in this matchup — you have no dash for her to cancel' and 'Poppy's W is dead utility against your kit'.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence's dash-stopping is only its active. Passively it grants Poppy armour and magic resist, and that bonus INCREASES as she drops low on health. Against a Tahm Kench whose entire plan is attrition, an enemy who gets more resistant the further you push her down is the opposite of dead utility — it is the reason the last third of her health bar takes longer than the first two.
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence passively gives her armour and MR that scale up as she gets low — the attrition plan slows down exactly when you think it is finishing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Iron Ambassador is never mentioned anywhere in either layer.
audit.why: Her passive throws a buckler that bounces off the target, and Poppy gains a shield if she picks it up. That is a denial play of the same kind as Olaf's axe — standing on the buckler removes the shield from the trade before it happens. The missing-interactions file flags this matchup for shield-absorbs-burst on Iron Ambassador specifically, and nothing in either layer acts on it.
audit.corrected: Stand on the dropped buckler. No pickup, no shield, and the trade maths change before you commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3], content.late and whys[6] teach 'the 3-stack stun into Devour' and 'a 3-stack Tongue Lash stun into Devour' as one action.
audit.why: Tongue Lash on a three-stack target stuns and consumes the stacks; devouring an enemy champion requires three stacks. In this matchup the choice is unusually pointed, because the stun is also what cancels Keeper's Verdict — so the player genuinely has to decide what those three stacks are for.
audit.corrected: Three stacks buys the stun that cancels her ult, or the Devour that removes her. Pick before you press.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet lists this matchup as never naming a single Poppy ability, and no cooldown number appears in either layer despite both repeating 'trade around Heroic Charge's cooldown'.
audit.why: Every ability was referred to only as Q/W/E/R, so a player could not look up or track any of them.
audit.corrected: Iron Ambassador (P), Hammer Shock (Q) 8/7/6/5/4s, Steadfast Presence (W) 20/18/16/14/12s, Heroic Charge (E) 14/13/12/11/10s at 475, Keeper's Verdict (R) 140/120/100s.

notes: This matchup named none of Poppy's five abilities, which the packet caught, but the more serious problem was underneath that: Hammer Shock is described as a knockup in five separate strings. It is a slow plus a delayed-detonation zone — there is no displacement in it at all, and the correct reaction (step off the zone before it explodes) is the opposite of the one the text implies. Worth grepping other entries for 'Poppy Q knockup'. Two interactions that were flagged in _missing-interactions.json and acted on nowhere: Keeper's Verdict is a channel that hard CC cancels, so the 3-stack Tongue Lash stun beats it outright rather than the entry's advice to fear and bait it; and Iron Ambassador's buckler can be denied by standing on it. Also corrected: content.late claimed Steadfast Presence is 'completely wasted' against Tahm Kench because he has no dash. Its passive armour and magic resist increase as Poppy drops low, which is directly adverse to an attrition win condition — the exact opposite of dead utility. Note Tahm Kench's own Abyssal Dive is not flagged as a dash in the kit file, so I did not claim anything either way about Steadfast Presence stopping it. Gender slips remain in shared full-layer boilerplate (breakdown.late, dontsFull[0].d) that cannot be uniquely targeted. No WKM_LINES errors observed.
